title: C_GetAttributeValue: cross-slot object handle not rejected
description: C_GetAttributeValue does not verify obj->slot_id matches the session's slot. C_DestroyObject does this check and returns CKR_OBJECT_HANDLE_INVALID correctly. C_GetAttributeValue (and likely C_Sign, C_Encrypt) skip this validation. Per PKCS#11 sec.11.7, object handles are slot-scoped; a session on slot 0 must not access objects belonging to slot 1.
